description: A concise engineering document that captures an architectural context, the chosen decision, rejected alternatives with reasons, and both positive and negative consequences.
A component rendered exclusively on the server whose third-party dependencies (such as Markdown parsers or syntax highlighters) contribute 0 KB to the browser JavaScript bundle.
Pushing the 'use client' directive down to the smallest stateful UI leaf (such as a variant picker) so surrounding layouts and data sections remain Server Components.
Using <Form action="/search"> for GET filter navigation so Next.js prefetches target layouts and updates URL search parameters without a full-page reload.
